result:
The minimum is 2·2022 − 3 = 4041. I constructed an example that attains it, but I am recalling the matching lower bound (at least 2n − 3 edges) from the known solution rather than proving it here.

**Construction (4041 edges).** Pick two users a and b and make them friends. Make every other user a friend of both a and b. This uses 1 + 2(2022 − 2) = 4041 friendships.

Any two users other than a and b have a and b as common friends, so they can become friends. After that, every other user is friends with every user other than themselves, so a and b share all of those users as common friends. Everyone ends up friends with everyone.

**Lower bound.** I did not derive this. As a sanity check, for n = 3 the formula gives 3 and for n = 4 it gives 5, and both match direct checking (K₄ minus an edge works, since the two non-adjacent users have two common friends).

ANSWER: 4041
